assets.name: 知识药水
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single finished potion inventory icon for a Slay the Spire 2 character mod. Create ONE isolated 2D hand-drawn game item on a genuinely transparent RGBA background, square canvas. Closely follow the visual language of the game's potion icons: bold thick charcoal outline, compact distinctive silhouette, broad saturated flat color areas, only two or three cel-shaded values, small cream glass highlights, very little internal detail. The entire bottle and stopper must fit inside the canvas with an even 9% clear margin; icon centered and filling most of the available area. A slight 15 degree tilt and readable three-quarter view. Designed to remain legible at 32 and 64 pixels. Text: none. No letters, labels with writing, numerals, border, pedestal, scene, people, cast ground shadow, atmospheric glow, floating decorative particles, gradients, realistic rendering, fine texture, crosshatching, or repeated patterns. Transparent background including all area outside the item silhouette.
Subject: a squat book-shaped rectangular clear glass potion bottle with softly rounded shoulders, a short narrow neck and a simple warm brown cork. Deep sapphire blue liquid fills the lower two thirds. ONE small cream-colored folded paper scroll with a visibly curled end floats diagonally inside the liquid, conveying knowledge gathered from books. The paper scroll is the large central motif; use just one dark crease, without writing. Glass edges pale cyan, dark blue flat shadow, simple broad white reflection on one edge. The recognizable outline is a wide compact scholarly potion, not a conventional book illustration.

Subject: a sturdy tall reusable sports squeeze bottle for an archer's daily physical training. A rounded asymmetric oval body, distinct broad shoulder and a simple closed pull-spout cap with two chunky shapes. Translucent warm amber body filled with bright orange-red electrolyte drink, one broad unlettered pale cream grip band around the middle and a dark brick-red cap. Strong simple modern athletic bottle silhouette with a slightly flattened base, rather than a medicine vial. A few large simplified internal bubbles are permitted. The training drink must look like a concrete drinkable item; one bottle, no dumbbells, no separate props, no writing or logo.

Subject: an unusual broad fan-shaped glass flask, a narrow short neck sealed with a single simple brown cork and a rounded flared lower body. Inside the bottle a clearly legible fan of exactly FIVE miniature silver arrowheads on dark shafts, diagonally rising together toward the upper right, partly immersed in rich violet liquid. Arrowheads broad and triangular, with a very simple notch, shafts thick and distinct, no fussy fletching. These arrows are entirely contained within the bottle and symbolize an entire volley waiting to be released. The dominant motif is the group of arrowheads, visible through the glass. Pale lavender glass edges and a few bold cream glass highlights. Keep the flask's silhouette asymmetrical and crisp, with no extra stars or ornamental ribbons.
